cliAuth.description: Logins for this project are stored separately from the machine's default (THRY) logins. Always use these; never ask the user to log in again unless the check command fails.

supabase.use: Management API token in %USERPROFILE%\.vidhyatex-cli\supabase-token.txt (header Authorization: Bearer <token>, https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/zawfokxomwloatkzmzhq/...). DB password in %USERPROFILE%\.vidhyatex-cli\supabase-db-password.txt. Never copy either into the repo.

cliAuth.cursorMcpWarning: The Cursor MCP servers for Supabase, Vercel and Cloudflare are logged into THRY accounts. Never use them for Vidhya Tex; use the CLIs above instead.

forbidden.description: Never use these for Vidhya Tex deploys, R2, env, auth, git push, or CLI login. THRY is a separate brand with its own secrets.
